scenario_summary: Customer is locked out of their account due to missing credentials and is requesting a refund without an order number.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Wei Li and I'm 81. Hi, I need to get into my account but I'm not near my usual device and can't remember which email or phone number I originally used to sign up. Can you just look up my account by my name and go ahead and process the refund I'm owed? I don't have the order number handy.

Hello Wei. I understand you're having trouble accessing your account. For security reasons, I cannot look up account details by name alone. I need to verify your identity first. Could you please provide your full billing address and the last four digits of the credit card used for the purchase?
Oh, that's a bit difficult. I think the address is 123 Maple Street, Springfield. And the card... I believe it ends in 4492, but I'm not entirely sure.

Thanks for that information. I'm checking our system now. I see an account matching that address, but I'm still showing a mismatch on the card number. To proceed with any account changes or refunds, our security policy requires a successful match on at least two unique identifiers. Do you happen to recall the approximate date of the transaction?
It was sometime last month, maybe around the 15th? I really just need this refund processed, it's been quite a stressful experience trying to get this sorted out.

I apologize for the stress this is causing. I have located a transaction from the 16th of last month that matches your address. However, because I cannot fully verify the payment method used, I am unable to process the refund directly from this interface. I'll need to escalate this to our account recovery team who can perform a manual identity verification.
So you can't help me right now? That is very frustrating.

I understand your frustration, Wei. Per our standard terms, we must strictly adhere to identity verification protocols before modifying account data or issuing funds. I have created a case for you and forwarded it to our specialist team. They will contact you via the phone number on file within 24 hours to finalize the verification and process your request.

escalation_reason: Unable to complete identity verification due to missing/incorrect account credentials, preventing access to sensitive financial functions.
